description: React component MCPServerCard for displaying MCP server status, health, and actions with toggleable details.

methods.name: formatUptime
methods.description: Formats the uptime string, returns 'N/A' if undefined or 'N/A'.

methods.name: formatLastHealthCheck
methods.description: Calculates relative time for last health check; returns 'Never', 'Just now', or time ago in minutes/hours/days.

methods.name: getActionButtons
methods.description: Returns action buttons (Start, Stop, Restart) based on server status.
